chinese: 恶魔广场是战士们证明勇气的地方。符合条件的战士将会收到恶魔广场通行证。带着恶魔之眼、恶魔之钥、玛雅之石和足够的金币前往仙踪林的玛雅哥布林。

chinese: 有人说MU大陆上的一些怪物身上发现了恶魔之眼。尝试猎杀尽可能多的怪物以获得恶魔之眼。如果你找到了，就去仙踪林与卡隆会面。

english: Many adventurers and warriors are crowding into Devil Square to prove their courage. Warrior, are you on your way to Devil Square?

source: existing zh-TW draft, simplified and manually reviewed; exact original key

english: Do not you want to prove that you are the bravest of the bravest. Opportunity lies ahead of you. If you get the Devil Eye and Key, you will be one step closer to that opportunity.
chinese: 难道你不想证明你是最勇敢的人吗？机会就在你面前。如果你得到了恶魔之眼和钥匙，你就离这个机会更近了一步。

source: existing zh-TW draft, simplified and manually reviewed; exact original key

english: Are you looking for the Devil Eye too? The Devil Eye can be found on most monsters on the MU continent. If God is with you, you will be able to find what you seek.

english: The season of blessing has come and the Golden Archer who collects Rena has appeared on the MU continent. If you take 10 Rena to the Golden Archer who stands in front of Lorencia, he will tell you a story about himself.
chinese: 祝福的季节到来，收集瑞纳的黄黄金弓箭手出现在MU大陆。如果你带着10个瑞纳去找站在勇者大陆面前的黄黄金弓箭手，他会告诉你一个关于他自己的故事。
source: existing zh-TW draft, simplified and manually reviewed; exact original key

english: 'Rena' is a type of gold coin that was used in the world of Heaven which had existed before the MU continent. If you bring Rena to the Golden Archer in front of Lorencia, he will give you a number of Lugard, the God of the world of Heaven.
chinese: ‘瑞纳’是一种在MU大陆之前就已经存在的天堂世界中使用的金币。如果你把瑞纳带到勇者大陆面前的黄黄金弓箭手那里，他会给你一些天界之神陆迦德。
source: existing zh-TW draft, simplified and manually reviewed; exact original key

english: After the ressurection of Kundun, some monsters have taken possession of what is called the Box of Heaven. If you find Rena in the box, bring it to the Golden Archer in front of Lorencia. It is said that he tells a story to those who bring 10 Renas.
chinese: 昆顿复活后，一些怪物占据了所谓的天之宝箱。如果你在盒子里找到了瑞纳，就把它带到勇者大陆面前的黄黄金弓箭手那里。据说他会给那些带着10个瑞纳斯的人讲一个故事。
source: existing zh-TW draft, simplified and manually reviewed; exact original key

english: You've brought 10 Rena. As a token of my appreciation, I will tell you a bit about Rena. Rena is made of a type of golden metal that doesn't exist in MU. Scholars have discovered through their studies that Rena comes from the world of Heaven.
chinese: 你带来了 10 个瑞纳。为了表达我的谢意，我会告诉你一些关于瑞纳的事。瑞纳是由MU中不存在的一种金金属制成的。学者通过研究发现，瑞纳来自天界。
source: existing zh-TW draft, simplified and manually reviewed; exact original key

english: Rena embodies a very strong power source of mana and it is said that ancient wizards used to create powerful spells with Rena. While studying the world of Heaven, 'Etramu', the greatest wizard of ancient times, created un unbreakable magic metal called 'Secromicon' with the Rena that he had accidentally discovered.
chinese: 瑞纳体现了非常强大的魔法值源泉，据说古代巫师曾用瑞纳创造出强大的法术。在研究天堂世界时，古代最伟大的巫师“Etramu”用他偶然发现的Rena创造了坚不可摧的魔法金属“Secromicon”。
source: existing zh-TW draft, simplified and manually reviewed; exact original key

english: After then, scholars of MU studying Etramu discovered that the world of Heaven had actually existed and tried to solve the secret of the world of Heaven through Rena.
chinese: 此后，MU的学者研究Etramu发现天堂世界实际上存在，并试图通过Rena解开天堂世界的秘密。
source: existing zh-TW draft, simplified and manually reviewed; exact original key

english: But through constant war, all the Rena had disappeared and the studies couldn't be continued. I've tried to find Rena to solve the secret of the world of Heaven all my life.
chinese: 但由于不断的战争，瑞纳全部消失，研究无法继续。我一生都在试图寻找瑞纳来解开天堂世界的秘密。
source: existing zh-TW draft, simplified and manually reviewed; exact original key

english: After the resurrection of Kundun, I've discovered that some monsters on the continent surprisingly possessed the box of heaven. I don't know what Kundun exactly has in mind but one thing I'm sure is that Kundun is trying to use the power of Rena.
chinese: 昆顿复活后，我发现大陆上的一些怪物竟然拥有天之宝箱。我不知道昆顿到底在想什么，但我确信的一件事是昆顿正在尝试利用瑞纳的力量。
source: existing zh-TW draft, simplified and manually reviewed; exact original key

english: Before Kundun finds Rena hidden in Mu, we have to find them and figure out the secret and the origin of the power.
chinese: 在昆顿找到隐藏在穆中的瑞纳之前，我们必须找到他们并弄清楚秘密和力量的来源。
source: existing zh-TW draft, simplified and manually reviewed; exact original key
